title: The run library is here
body: Open Runs to search past runs by words or run id, replay a run's steps and video, and copy a link for a coworker. Opening a past run never changes the phone you picked for the next one. Videos and screenshots are not redacted, so check a run before you share it.

title: SmartQA is here
body: Connect a phone from Chrome—nothing to install. Runs go to the phone you picked. Sign in securely with your company account. GPT-6.1 Sol powers this round, and SmartQA updates automatically. This round ships the SmartQA workspace, What's New, compact copyable run IDs, and copyable run summaries.
